key.name: layout
key.description: JSON object with the ordered items of the left, center and right boxes and the list of hidden items

key.name: known-items
key.description: Maintained by the extension so the preferences window can list the panel items

key.name: item-inset
key.description: Distance in pixels from the edge of each panel item to its content. Neighbouring items, and the icons inside the system menu, end up twice this far apart

key.name: item-padding-overrides
key.description: JSON object mapping item keys to a button padding in pixels that replaces the value derived from the item spacing. -1 keeps the theme default
